messages:
anna: FYI - nightly eval (rwd-model-v2-quant) showed a ~3% regression on math_reasoning prompt set. Sometimes it fails, sometimes passes. Anyone else seeing nondeterministic diffs? :confused:

ci-bot: nightly-eval job started (id=nightly/1767854321)

mike: yep. I re-ran locally with --seed 42 twice. First run matched baseline, second had 2 failed prompts. Divergence occurs around token 12 in several generations.

olivia: could be quant backend nondeterminism (int8 kernels). Also saw similar on A100 when parallel threads !=1. Try export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 and CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 to check.

anna: repro command I used:
```
./scripts/run_eval.sh --model rwd-model-v2-quant --prompts prompts/math_reasoning.json --seed 42 --shots 0
```
Attached a short diff: (pass vs fail excerpts)

mike: harness note: I found a bug where shuffle_prompts() used time.time() when seed==None but one test path calls it with seed unset even when other code sets global seed. I can push a fix to ensure all codepaths respect --seed.

olivia: filed PR 1298 to force deterministic prompt ordering and to log rng state at start of each job. Also adding a small retry detector: if nightly sees nondet (same seed different outputs) mark as flaky and create a flakiness issue instead of regressing.

anna: thanks. For immediate triage I'll re-run the nightly job with OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 and pin cuBLAS deterministic flags. Will share logs.

mike: also add a tiny harness test that runs the same seed 3x and asserts identical generations. Helps catch nondet during PRs.

olivia: agreed. I'll also add a note in eng-ml channel when PR merges. :eyes:

ci-bot: job nightly/1767854321 rerun triggered by anna (reason: deterministic-repro)
